name: 70801 · Baton Rouge, LA
findings: ZIP 70801 (Baton Rouge) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70801 (Baton Rouge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70801 (Baton Rouge) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 15.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
